The operator confirmed the existing game rasters on 2026-07-29. The nine housing rasters added on 2026-08-06, the nine ranch and cooking rasters added on 2026-08-10, the six Star Grave environment and monster rasters added on 2026-08-14, the 37 dangerous-fishing and ranch/cooking rasters added on 2026-08-15, the six ranch cooking rasters added on 2026-08-16, the 55 cooking-research recipe rasters added on 2026-08-22, the five dangerous-fishing realtime rasters added on 2026-08-22, and the nine dangerous-fishing species rasters added on 2026-08-23 were generated for this repository in operator-controlled Codex/OpenAI image-generation sessions. The 2026-08-22 boss sheets use cleared repository fish artwork for identity and style; a user-supplied, non-deployed golem sheet served only as a generic spacing/motion-layout reference, with no pixels, character identity, palette, anatomy, or style carried into the deployed assets. No source-unknown downloads, unverified purchased assets, or copied third-party characters or trademarks are included in deployed game art.

The operator confirmed on 2026-07-29 that all current app icons and social-preview images were created directly, generated through an account they control, or licensed for public distribution in this game. The Google Play feature graphic added on 2026-08-08 was generated for this repository from its operator-cleared village artwork in the operator-controlled Codex/OpenAI image-generation session.
